Resolves #19514

A dock commit no longer paints the workspace empty. The Reconciler's visibility swap now also takes the outgoing shell out of layout: it gets a `neo-dashboard-dock-shell-retiring` class, which the dashboard stylesheet sets to `display: none` for every shell shape. A root tabs node projects a `neo-tab-container`, so the rule doubles the class rather than naming a base class. The incoming shell now fills the host in the frame it becomes visible; before, it sat past the host's edge until cleanup destroyed the old shell. The per-phase host updates are unchanged. A swap whose flight fails returns the surviving shell to layout. Inside the swap window, `Reconciler.liveShell` hands the Maximize plugin the incoming shell.

Evidence: L3 headless (the continuity arm samples layout at every painted frame; the components arm reads computed style at the swap) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-3, AC-4). AC-2: Mnemosyne's recorded headed run on the operator's display, at `ed40abe12c`. No residual.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | The fingerprint on #19514 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19514#issuecomment-6085083444)). At every commit, for 2–4 painted frames, the old shell (x=12, no tab containers) sits beside the staged shell (x=1268, 6 tab containers) in the 1280-px host. |
| AC-2 | Mnemosyne's recorded headed run of the film tour at `ed40abe12c`, before the merge ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/19516#issuecomment-6085626541)). It shows 0 whole-workspace blank frames at document commits; the red take showed 9. The head since changes two things the tour does not reach: the rule now also covers tab-root shells (the Workstation's root is an edge zone, a `neo-container`, which both rules match), and Maximize measures differently only inside a swap window. |
| AC-3 | `WorkstationCommitContinuity.spec.mjs` (e2e, CI): across the dense tour's first three commits, the visible pane area never falls below half its settled value. An empty, non-finite or unbaselined sample fails it. `DockShellRetirement.spec.mjs` (components, CI) uses the bare-consumer fixture's tab root: the outgoing shell computes `display: none` at the swap and the incoming one starts at x=0, while a retained root stages a shell and is never marked. `DockProjectionReconciler.spec.mjs` covers the swap flight and a failed swap's survivor. |
| AC-4 | The FLIP receipts `DockMotionNL` and `WorkstationDockFlipResizeNL` pass with the fix, 8/8 at `ed40abe12c`; the head since changes neither FLIP nor how the Workstation's shells lay out. |

## Deltas from ticket
- **The seam is the Reconciler's in-flow staging, not the FLIP layer**, per the fingerprint. FLIP is untouched.
- **AC-3's arms read layout and computed style, not pixels.** They see what end-state receipts and the 250 ms sampler could not. The pixel claim is AC-2's.
- **Maximize measures `Reconciler.liveShell`.** A workspace that is its own host measured the retiring, `display: none` shell inside the swap window and failed maximize closed (CI components 1/3 at `ed40abe12c`).
- **Found, filed separately: #19521.** When a commit nests the tab root into a split, or collapses a split to one of its tabs nodes, the tabs node stays hidden afterwards. This exists on `dev`. Here, the nest case gets `display: none` instead of `visibility: hidden`.

## Test Evidence
- **The e2e arm, red then green:** without the `src` and `scss` change: `the visible pane area collapsed across a commit (settled at 84%)`. With the change: passes 3/3 at `ed40abe12c`, and again at `e93602e0ed`.
- **The tab-root arm, red then green:** with the `.neo-container`-qualified rule, the outgoing tab root computes `display: flex` and the incoming shell starts at x=1280. With the doubled class it passes 3/3.
- **Components, locally:** `DockShellRetirement`, `DockPreviewGeometry` and `DockMaximize` pass 24/24. The full tier's only local failures are `MarkdownLinkNavigability` (7) and `MonacoEditor` (9), the same 16 as `dev` 3ab4a3f158.
- **Unit:** `test/playwright/unit/dashboard/` passes 1286, skips 2. The swap pin fails without the `src` change, and the phase-3 recovery case fails when the survivor's class cleanup is removed.
- **FLIP:** `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT=<my Brain checkout at e74cd6fd> NEO_NL_PORT=8193 npx playwright test dashboard/DockMotionNL workstation/WorkstationDockFlipResizeNL -c test/playwright/playwright.config.e2e.mjs --workers=1` passes 8/8, on a private bridge off the shared `:8081`.
